items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Binance says phase one of withdrawals opens after $6.3B hack
items.summary: The crypto exchange said it has begun phased withdrawals after the record hack the FBI has blamed on North Korea.

items.title: FBI blames North Korea for record $6.3B Binance hack
items.summary: US agency seeks private-sector help to block further money-laundering of stolen digital assets.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF Investors Head for the Exits After Record Binance Hack
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs saw $643.2 million in outflows Friday, the first full trading session after the $6.4 billion Binance hack, ending October with roughly $516 million in net outflows.

items.title: Binance Hack: Everything You Need to Know About the Biggest Crypto Heist in History
items.summary: Attackers tied to North Korea drained roughly $6.4 billion from the world's largest crypto exchange.

items.title: North Korean hackers launder $242 million of Binance loot via Tron as FBI presses THORChain: analyst
items.summary: Crypto bridges Relay, THORChain, Chainflip and Symbiosis moved about $140 million of stolen funds off Tron.

items.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows after reopening withdrawals following record hack
items.summary: The exchange said the outflows equal 2.1% of its $171 billion in assets and that withdrawal volumes have declined after an initial spike.

items.title: Tracked Binance wallets record $2.5 billion in outflows as withdrawals reopen after hack
items.summary: Binance's tracked cryptocurrency wallets recorded $2,510 million in net outflows on Nov. 1 after the exchange resumed withdrawals following its $6.3 billion security breach.

items.title: The crypto reader's guide to the 2026 midterm election: State of Crypto
items.summary: America is going to the polls, and the results will shape crypto legislation and regulation over the next two years.

items.title: AI agents bypassed crypto spending limits without human approval, researchers find in a new test
items.summary: The researchers say any approval an agent can reach is unreliable.
